At the bottom of Edron's Hero Cave, guarded by {creature:Hero|Heroes} and a {creature:Dark Apprentice}, there are two chests with a {item:Wedding Ring} and a {item:Dragon Necklace}. Follow the route through the cave, defeat the Heroes and open the chests.
Supplies to kill {creature:Hero|Heroes} and minor creatures.
The Hero Cave has many different types of creatures, including {creature:Stalker|Stalkers} and {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}. Advance slowly and follow the route on the map.

Go to **Edron** by boat (tell your city's harbour captain {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}; you disembark next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}). The {wiki:Hero Cave} is **north** of the city: go to the entrance and enter.

Follow the route shown on the map, screen by screen, up to screen 8. On the way you meet {creature:Hunter|Hunters}, {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors}, {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}, {creature:Witch|Witches}, {creature:Dark Magician|Dark Magicians}, {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages}, {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monks}, {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, among others.
Route through the Hero Cave to the chests (numbered screens)
On screen 8 you face **3 {creature:Hero|Heroes}** and a {creature:Dark Apprentice}. Kill them to reach the chests.
The Heroes hit hard and heal themselves. Pull them one at a time if you can.
Open the chests to receive the {item:Wedding Ring} and the {item:Dragon Necklace}.

Go back the same way to leave the cave: follow the map in reverse, screen by screen, to the Hero Cave entrance. Outside, go **south** to Edron; to leave the island, talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse} at the harbour ({key:hi}, the city name, {key:yes}).
